gate-node.receipt.no_agent_header: decision: same; requireAgentMatch also lets a missing header through

gate-node.classify.unprotected: by design: a root mount paywalls an unregistered path at the mount default

gate-node.path.case_no_discount: needs a canonical path in the core: an unregistered spelling is priced at the mount default
